Venetian Plaster in Wishaw and Glasgow

Darren applies Venetian plaster feature walls across Wishaw, Motherwell, Glasgow, North Lanarkshire and the Central Belt, in styles from marble effects to pitted stone finishes. He trained with Venezia Stucco in Essex, who supply the materials, and is an approved installer for Venezia Stucco.

Call 07767 446273 WhatsApp Us

Trained With Venezia Stucco in Essex

"We did our training with Venezia Stucco in Essex and we have our material supplied by them. Venezia Stucco have been in business for a long time and were one of the first companies to start Venetian plaster training in the UK, so that's why we chose them."

Darren, DRN Plastering Co

Marble Effects to Pitted Stone

There are many different Venetian styles that can go on a feature wall, from marble effects to pitted, stone like finishes. The staircase wall below is a high gloss polished finish; the media wall is a textured one in warm tones above an inset fire.

Venetian or Microcement?

Darren trained for both, with a different supplier for each. Venetian is the one for a feature wall, where the finish itself is the point: a marble vein, a polished shine or a pitted stone look. Microcement is, in his words, the more subtle finish but the more robust product, which is why it goes on floors, in bathrooms and wet rooms, and over old tiles. If you can't decide, send a photo of the wall on WhatsApp and ask him which would suit it.
